evidence.quote:
STR Submission Methods for Regulated Entities
Upon the launch of STREAMS 2, regulated entities will no longer be able to submit STRs via email, fax, or post. All STRs must be submitted electronically through STREAMS 2. Under STREAMS 2, regulated entities will have three submission options:-
Submit STR via XML Submission (Hong Kong Post e-cert is required);
Upload a completed STR in prescribed PDF format in STREAMS 2 (Hong Kong Post e-cert is required); and
Complete the STR web-form directly in STREAMS 2.

User Account Registration
For reporting institutions who wish to open STREAMS 2 user accounts, please complete the “STREAMS 2 User Registration Form”, available for download on JFIU website and submit the completed form to JFIU (jfiu@police.gov.hk).

missing_premises: Applicability evidence is missing for the assessed submission: reporting institution identity and regulated-entity status, submission time, applicable STREAMS 2 instructions or specification version, and actual XML or prescribed-PDF submission method. These are proposed assessment evidence fields, not source-prescribed XML/PDF fields.
The accepted Hong Kong Post e-cert product or certificate class, eligible holder and required relationship between holder, reporting institution, account user and signer are not specified.

The selections do not establish whether the certificate signs the document, an XML payload, a submission envelope or another object, or whether it is used for authentication. Signature format, signed content, verification rules and differences between XML and PDF remain unspecified.

Account registration is expressly described, but it does not establish authority to sign or submit for the institution. Required authorization, delegation, role assignment and certificate-to-account or certificate-to-institution binding remain unknown.
Certificate validity conditions and the relevant evaluation time are unspecified, including any expiry, revocation, trust-chain, permitted-use or timestamp checks.

The exact operational evidence fields and their acceptance rules remain unestablished. Candidate assessment fields requiring confirmation include certificate identity and class, holder identity, institutional binding, signer and submitter identities, authorization record, signed-content identifier, signature-verification result, validity-check time and results, and submission acknowledgment. These are investigative proposals, not established mandatory fields.

No assessed certificate, signed payload, authorization record or submission validation record is supplied. The other supplied selections do not resolve these mechanics; files with empty selections and unselected text cannot supply the missing authority.
next_source_questions: Obtain the official JFIU STREAMS 2 XML submission and prescribed-PDF upload technical instructions applicable to the assessed submission, or a tested submission specification with identified version and scope: what exact certificate and signature checks must each branch satisfy?

Obtain the official certificate eligibility and account-binding instructions: which Hong Kong Post e-cert classes and holders are accepted, and how must the certificate holder relate to the reporting institution, signer and account user?

Obtain the relevant STREAMS 2 registration, user-role and signing-authorization instructions, together with the assessed institution's completed authorization and account-binding records: who may sign and submit, and what proves that authority?

Obtain the applicable signature-validation specification or documented test cases: what is signed, how is integrity verified, when is certificate validity evaluated, and how are expiry, revocation and any timestamp requirements handled?

Obtain the assessed XML/PDF submission, associated certificate and signature-verification records, applicable institutional authorization, and system acknowledgment or validation report: which confirmed requirements were actually satisfied, and what does the system response establish?
value.proposition: Express provision: the supplied JFIU notice states that, upon the launch of STREAMS 2, regulated entities must submit STRs electronically through STREAMS 2 and that both XML submission and upload of a completed STR in the prescribed PDF format require a Hong Kong Post e-cert. Inference: the supported branch trigger is an assessed STR submission by a regulated entity through STREAMS 2, under the announced post-launch arrangements, using either XML submission or prescribed-PDF upload. This establishes a certificate requirement, not the exact predicate for satisfying that requirement. Assumptions: this proposed trigger applies only if the assessed institution's regulated-entity status, submission system, applicable arrangements and actual submission method are independently established; none is established merely by publication, downloading or the supplied file hashes. The notice does not specify certificate signing, eligible holder, institutional authorization or validity mechanics. Its separate listing of a web-form option without an e-cert parenthetical does not expressly establish a general certificate exemption. The operational certificate-mechanics question remains open.
